import json as codec
import tomllib
from json import loads as decode
from pathlib import Path

# Keep this source comment and the import aliases.
first = codec.loads(Path("one.json").read_text())  # trailing
second = decode(
    Path("two.json").read_text()  # payload comment
)
third = tomllib.loads(Path("config.toml").read_text())
explicit_encoding = decode(Path("three.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def shadow(codec, decode):
    return codec.loads(Path("local").read_text()), decode(Path("local").read_text())

message = t"loaded {first}"
